part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts:261`: when an `inputSourceMap` has no `sourcesContent` array (undefined), accessing `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`. Changed it to optional chaining `this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`, so missing source content is simply passed as `undefined` to `setSourceContent`.

Verified:
- `make build-no-bundle` compiles cleanly
- Reproduction with an input map lacking `sourcesContent` no longer throws
- All `babel-generator` (591) and `babel-core` (452) tests pass
